title: Vegetable Stir Fry
instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large wok or pan over high heat
2. Add garlic and ginger, stir for 30 seconds until fragrant
3. Add carrots and broccoli, stir-fry for 3-4 minutes
4. Add bell peppers and onions, cook for another 2-3 minutes
5. Pour in soy sauce and season with salt and pepper
6. Stir-fry for another 2 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp
7. Serve hot with rice or noodles

title: Berry Smoothie Bowl
instructions:
1. Combine frozen banana, strawberries, blueberries, and almond milk in a blender
2. Blend until smooth and creamy
3. Add honey or maple syrup to taste
4. Pour into a bowl and top with granola, chia seeds, and fresh berries
5. Serve immediately

title: Classic Cheese Omelette
instructions:
1. Whisk eggs with milk, salt, and pepper until frothy
2. Melt butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat
3. Pour egg mixture into the pan
4. Cook until edges start to set, then push cooked portions to center
5. When eggs are mostly set, sprinkle cheese on one half
6. Fold the other half over the cheese
7. Cook for another minute until cheese melts
8. Garnish with chives and serve

title: Creamy Tomato Pasta
instructions:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté onions until soft
3. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute
4. Pour in tomato sauce and simmer for 10 minutes
5. Stir in heavy cream and heat through
6. Season with salt, pepper, and fresh basil
7. Drain pasta and mix with sauce
8. Serve with grated Parmesan cheese

title: Grilled Chicken Salad
instructions:
1. Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper
2. Grill chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through
3. Let chicken rest, then slice
4. In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, cucumber, tomatoes, and onion
5. Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper for dressing
6. Toss salad with dressing
7. Top with sliced chicken and fresh herbs
8. Serve immediately

title: Avocado Toast with Egg
instructions:
1. Toast bread until golden and crisp
2. Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper
3. Fry or poach eggs to your preference
4. Spread avocado mixture on toast
5. Top with eggs and sprinkle with red pepper flakes
6. Garnish with microgreens
7. Serve immediately

title: Hearty Vegetable Soup
instructions:
1. Heat olive oil in a large pot
2. Sauté onions, carrots, and celery until softened
3. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute
4. Add potatoes, vegetable broth, thyme, and bay leaf
5. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Remove bay leaf before serving
8. Serve hot with crusty bread

title: Yogurt Parfait
instructions:
1. In a glass or bowl, layer half the yogurt
2. Add a layer of mixed berries
3. Sprinkle with half the granola
4. Repeat layers with remaining ingredients
5. Drizzle with honey and top with nuts
6. Garnish with mint leaves
7. Serve immediately

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp
instructions:
1. Pat shrimp dry and season with salt and pepper
2. Heat butter and olive oil in a large pan
3. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant
4. Add shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side
5. Add lemon juice and red pepper flakes
6. Stir in fresh parsley
7. Serve immediately with rice or crusty bread

title: Chocolate Banana Smoothie
instructions:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender
2. Blend until smooth and creamy
3. Add ice cubes if desired for thicker consistency
4. Pour into a glass
5. Top with whipped cream if using
6. Serve immediately
